$schema: N/A — no loader consumes this file yet; see README note below
description: Example Wish-Granted Item content for the Genie house system (spec 018-genie-house-system, User Story 5). Each entry maps directly onto spec 013-items-inventory's existing `createItem` / `addItemEffect` GraphQL mutations (see specs/013-items-inventory/contracts/graphql-items.md) — field names below mirror `CreateItemInput` and `ItemEffectInput` exactly (camelCase, as the mutations receive them over GraphQL). This is DATA to hand to those existing mutations, not a new content-loading pipeline: as of this writing there is no established 'seed pack content' loader anywhere in packs/systems/ (checked packs/systems/dnd5e/ for a precedent — none exists), so this file establishes a first, deliberately unopinionated example of the pattern rather than inventing a loader to consume it. A future spec can add a `system.json` `seedContent` pointer + import script if/when a second system wants the same thing.

items.name: Lamp of Minor Binding
items.description: A dented brass lamp still warm from its last wish. Rubbing it doesn't summon a genie anymore — the binding was spent — but the residual magic can still lash out at whatever the wielder points it at.

items.name: Sash of Woven Favor
items.description: Threads pulled from a genie's own vestments, woven into a wearable sash. It hums faintly whenever its wearer calls in a favor.

items.name: Vial of Bottled Essence
items.description: A stoppered glass vial holding a single swirling mote of raw wish-essence, siphoned off during a bargain that never fully resolved. Drinking it stings, then mends.
